name: Motorcycle Simulator Online
summary:
Ride with your friends, from the seat - all the way round Charlotte, North Carolina.

RIDE ONLINE TOGETHER
Up to four riders in a room. Quick Ride joins an open room or opens yours; Private Room gives you a 4-digit code for friends. See each other's bikes and riders leaning into the bends, with names and speeds over them, hear their engines and horns, and talk with optional voice chat.
